Deterministic Product Composer (Phase 6)
Describe the product. Get the interface.

Tessellate understands product architecture without requiring an LLM. Enter your product brief below to generate a validated ProductModel, ScreenGraph, and three design directions.

Compose Interface System
Inferred Product Architecture

Deterministic inferences derived from brief vocabulary and archetype priors.

Schema Valid (ProductModel 1.0.0)
DETERMINISTIC ASSUMPTIONS
Identified primary archetype as "Analytics Platform" based on domain vocabulary.
Inferred target audience as "Data analysts, executives, and growth product managers".
Inferred primary objective: "Transform raw event data into actionable quantitative intelligence and reports".
Applied feel descriptors "professional but playful" with mathematical DNA adjustments.
Applied Visual Ambition level 30 to motion, typography, and depth.
Applied Structural Creativity level 55 to spatial topology.
Primary Archetype
ANALYTICS
User Sophistication
80/100
Trust Requirement
90/100
Data Density
95/100
Information Complexity
85/100
Mobile Priority
45/100
Planned ScreenGraph (8 Screens)

Structured screen classes, route slugs, required section roles, and navigation hierarchy.

5 Required
3 Optional
MARKETING GROUP
Marketing Home
/
Required

Product value proposition, interactive preview, and conversion funnel.

Required Roles: navigation, hero, value-proposition...
Documentation & API
/docs
Optional

Technical integration guides, API endpoints, and SDK references.

Required Roles: docs-sidebar, prose-article, on-this-page-toc...
APPLICATION GROUP
Overview Dashboard
/overview
Required

Central operational telemetry, KPI scorecard, and high-priority action queue.

Required Roles: overview-header, metric-cards, activity-feed...
Metric Directory
/metrics
Required

Searchable, filterable catalog of all metric records.

Required Roles: index-header, filter-bar, data-table...
Metric Detail
/metrics/:id
Optional

Deep inspection, metadata attributes, timeline, and actions for a single metric.

Required Roles: entity-header, detail-tabs, main-content-pane...
Analytics & Insights
/analytics
Optional

Deep time-series breakdown, cohort retention, and reporting exports.

Required Roles: date-range-picker, chart-canvas, summary-kpis...
SETTINGS & ADMINISTRATION GROUP
Settings & Preferences
/settings
Required

User profile, notification triggers, security keys, and display theme.

Required Roles: settings-nav, settings-form, save-footer...
AUTHENTICATION GROUP
Sign In
/sign-in
Required

User authentication with GitHub OAuth and session tokens.

Required Roles: auth-card, auth-footer...
Three Generated Directions

Deterministic directions generated from intent: conservative fit, expressive fit, and structural alternative.

DIRECTION 01
Conservative Fit
Calm Foundation

Closest to inferred product priors with standard sidebar navigation, reinforced accessibility floors, and rock-solid predictable ergonomics.
